description_en: Queries the documentation of an API
description_zh: 查询指定API的服务说明文档
name: DescribeApiDoc

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The environment name. Valid values:

RELEASE

TEST

If this parameter is not specified, the default value RELEASE is used
parameters.help_zh:
环境名称，可选值：

RELEASE: 线上
TEST: 测试

若不传入，则默认为release
parameters.name: stage_name

AuthType.description_en: The security authentication method. Valid values: APP, ANONYMOUS, and APPOPENID, indicating respectively Alibaba Cloud application authentication, anonymous authentication, and third-party OpenID Connect account authentication
AuthType.description_zh: 安全认证方式，取值为：APP、ANONYMOUS，分别表示阿里云APP、匿名

DisableInternet.description_en:
Specifies whether to set DisableInternet to true to limit API calls to within the VPC.

If you set DisableInternet to false, the limit is lifted. The default value is false when you create an API
DisableInternet.description_zh:
设置DisableInternet为true, 仅支持内网调用API。
设置DisableInternet为false, 则不限制调用。创建API时默认为false

ErrorCodeSample.description_en: The sample error codes returned by the backend service
ErrorCodeSample.description_zh: 后端服务返回的错误码示例

items.description_en: The sample error codes returned by the backend service
items.description_zh: 后端服务返回的错误码示例

FailResultSample.description_en: The sample error response from the backend service
FailResultSample.description_zh: 后端服务失败返回应答的示例

ForceNonceCheck.description_en:
Specifies whether to set ForceNonceCheck to true to force the check of X-Ca-Nonce during the request. This is the unique identifier of the request and is generally identified by UUID. After receiving this parameter, API Gateway verifies the validity of this parameter. The same value can be used only once within 15 minutes. This helps prevent replay attacks.

If you set ForceNonceCheck to false, the check is not performed. The default value is false when you create an API
ForceNonceCheck.description_zh:
设置ForceNonceCheck为true, 请求时强制检查X-Ca-Nonce，这个是请求的唯一标识，一般使用UUID来标识。API网关收到这个参数后会校验这个参数的有效性，同样的值，15分内只能被使用一次。可以有效防止API的重放攻击。

设置ForceNonceCheck为false，则不检查。创建API时默认为false

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the API group

GroupName.description_en: The name of the API group

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the API group

RequestConfig.description_en: The returned API frontend definition. It is an array consisting of RequestConfig data
RequestConfig.description_zh: 由 RequestConfig 组成的格式，返回API前端定义信息

BodyFormat.description_en:
This parameter takes effect only when the RequestMode parameter is set to MAPPING.\\\\

The server data transmission method used for POST and PUT requests. Valid values: FORM and STREAM. FORM indicates that data in key-value pairs is transmitted as forms. STREAM indicates that data is transmitted as byte streams
BodyFormat.description_zh:
当RequestMode值为MAPPING时有效。

POST/PUT请求时，表示数据以何种方式传递给服务器，取值为：FORM、STREAM，分别表示表单形式(k-v对应)、字节流形式

EscapePathParam.description_en: Whether to escape the Path parameter, if true, the [param] on the Path will be treated as a regular character
EscapePathParam.description_zh: 是否转义Path参数，如果为true，则Path上的[param]将被视为普通字符

PostBodyDescription.description_en: The description of the request body

RequestHttpMethod.description_en: The HTTP method used to make the request. Valid values: GET, POST, DELETE, PUT, HEADER, TRACE, PATCH, CONNECT, and OPTIONS

RequestMode.description_en:
The request mode. Valid values:

MAPPING: Parameters are mapped. Unknown parameters are filtered out.

PASSTHROUGH: Parameters are passed through.

MAPPING_PASSTHROUGH: Parameters are mapped. Unknown parameters are passed through
RequestMode.description_zh:
入参请求的模式，取值为：

MAPPING：入参映射（过滤未知参数）

PASSTHROUGH：入参透传

MAPPING_PASSTHROUGH：入参映射（透传未知参数）

RequestPath.description_en: The API request path. If the complete API URL is `http://api.a.com:8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`, the API request path is `/object/add `
RequestPath.description_zh: API path，比如API的完全地址为`http://api.a.com：8080/object/add?key1=value1&key2=value2`，path是指`/object/add`这一部分

RequestProtocol.description_en: The protocol type supported by the API. Valid values: HTTP and HTTPS. Separate multiple values with commas (,), such as "HTTP,HTTPS"
RequestProtocol.description_zh: API 支持的协议类型，可以多选，多选情况下以英文逗号隔开，如：”HTTP,HTTPS”，取值为：HTTP、HTTPS

RequestParameter.description_en: The returned frontend input parameters in the API. It is an array consisting of RequestParameter data
RequestParameter.description_zh: 由 RequestParameter 组成的数组格式，返回API中前端入参信息项

items.description_en: The returned frontend input parameters in the API. It is an array consisting of RequestParameter data
items.description_zh: 由 RequestParameter 组成的数组格式，返回API中前端入参信息项

ApiParameterName.description_en: The name of the parameter in the API request

ArrayItemsType.description_en: The type of the array element

DocOrder.description_en: The order in which the parameter is sorted in the document

DocShow.description_en: Indicates whether the document is public. Valid values: PUBLIC and PRIVATE

EnumValue.description_en: The hash values that are supported when ParameterType is set to Int, Long, Float, Double, or String. Separate values with commas (,). Examples: 1,2,3,4,9 and A,B,C,E,F
EnumValue.description_zh: 当ParameterType=Int、Long、Float、Double或String，允许输入的散列值，不同的值用英文的逗号分隔，形如：1,2,3,4,9或A,B,C,E,F

Location.description_en: The parameter location. Valid values: BODY, HEAD, QUERY, and PATH

ParameterType.description_en: The data type of the parameter

RegularExpression.description_en: The regular expression that is used for parameter validation when ParameterType is set to String
RegularExpression.description_zh: 当ParameterType=String，参数验证（正则表达式）

Required.description_en: Indicates whether the parameter is required

StageName.description_en:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

RELEASE

TEST
StageName.description_zh:
环境名称，可选值：

RELEASE: 线上
TEST: 测试

Visibility.description_en: Indicates whether the API is public. Valid values: PUBLIC and PRIVATE
Visibility.description_zh: 可见性，取值为：PUBLIC、PRIVATE，分别表示公开、私有
